column1: # Inheritance bridges for Forge 1.20.1 mods (26.3 names): target<TAB>method<TAB>when (or -)<TAB>helper<TAB>evidence
# A bridge is added to mod classes that extend/implement target and declare `when` (their old override), or with -,
# to concrete mod classes missing the method. Helpers live in eras/era-1.20.1 (rose.era.v1_20_1.bridge).

column5: 1.21.2: Recipe<T extends RecipeInput>.matches(T, Level) replaced matches(Container, Level)
26.3 Recipe.assemble(T) has no RegistryAccess parameter (1.20.1: assemble(Container, RegistryAccess))
26.3 RecipeSerializer is a record of codecs; 1.20.1 serializers are LegacyRecipeSerializer, adapted at registration
26.3 Recipe.group() is abstract; 1.20.1 Recipe.getGroup() defaulted to ""
26.3 Recipe.showNotification() is abstract; 1.20.1 defaulted to true

26.3 Recipe.placementInfo() (recipe book placement) did not exist in 1.20.1; its inputs come from 1.20.1 Recipe.getIngredients() (default: empty list). 26.3 RecipeManager ignores a non-special recipe whose placement info is empty
26.3 Recipe.recipeBookCategory() did not exist in 1.20.1 (client-side RecipeBookCategories)
1.20.5: Block.use(state, level, pos, player, hand, hit) split into useItemOn (holding an item) and useWithoutItem
1.20.5: Block.use split; useWithoutItem is the empty-hand case (main hand)
1.21.2: updateShape(state, level, ticks, pos, direction, neighborPos, neighborState, random) replaced (state, direction, neighborState, level, pos, neighborPos)
1.21.5: onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving) became affectNeighborsAfterRemoval(state, serverLevel, pos, movedByPiston); block entity drops moved to BlockEntity.preRemoveSideEffects
26.x: comparator output gets the side being read (Direction)
1.21.4: getCloneItemStack(LevelReader, pos, state, includeData) replaced (BlockGetter, pos, state)

1.21.2: getOcclusionShape(state) dropped the level and position
1.21.5: fall distance became a double

1.21.2: Item.use returns InteractionResult (carrying the transformed held stack) instead of InteractionResultHolder<ItemStack>
1.21.5: appendHoverText(stack, context, display, consumer, flag) replaced (stack, level, list, flag)
1.21: getUseDuration gained the using entity
26.x: container screens draw their texture in Screen.extractBackground(graphics, mouseX, mouseY, a); 1.20.1 renderBg(graphics, partialTick, mouseX, mouseY) was called by render
1.21.2: RecipeUpdateListener.fillGhostRecipe(RecipeDisplay) is new; old screens have no recipe book to fill (LegacyRecipeBookComponent)

1.20.5: Item.hurtEnemy returns void (wear moved to postHurtEnemy / the weapon component); 1.20.1 hurtEnemy returned boolean and wore the item itself
1.20.1 Item.canAttackBlock(state, level, pos, player) (mapped to canDestroyBlock); 26.3 canDestroyBlock(ItemStack, BlockState, Level, BlockPos, LivingEntity)

26.x: Container.startOpen/stopOpen take a ContainerUser (26.3 Container.java: default void startOpen(ContainerUser)); 1.20.1 took the Player
